title: Policy for coding tools
one_line: Allow, ask or deny what Claude Code, Cursor and Codex may run.
verified_against: Claude Code 2.1.330 (real binary, driven with claude -p against a local stub model API: deny, ask, allow, fail-open, fail-closed and undo). Cursor and Codex CLI hooks built from their documentation (2026-11-21/22) and tested only with documented payloads; never run against those tools.
